funds.name: S&P 500 (USA)
funds.access_note: Accessible via several Indian FoFs (e.g. Nasdaq 100/S&P 500 feeder funds), though SEBI has periodically capped fresh inflows into these on RBI's overseas-investment limit.

funds.name: DAX (Germany)
funds.access_note: Very limited retail-accessible route from India - a rare Europe-focused FoF at best, subject to the same overseas-investment cap.

funds.name: Nikkei 225 (Japan)
funds.access_note: A small number of Japan-focused FoFs exist (e.g. Nippon India Japan Equity), subject to the same overseas-investment cap.

funds.name: TAIEX (Taiwan)
funds.access_note: No common retail-accessible fund route from India.

funds.name: KOSPI (South Korea)
funds.access_note: No common retail-accessible fund route from India.
